description.value: Table: Summon Monster V Creature Subtype(s) Bunyip* [(holy/shadow)] Demon (Chaotic, Demon, Evil, Extraplanar) Ereshkigal (Devil, Evil, Extraplanar, Lawful) Elemental (Large) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Flying Killer* [(holy/shadow)] Great Tortoise* (Reptilian, [holy/shadow]) Greater Mantis* [(holy/shadow)] Killer Shark* (Aquatic, [holy/shadow]) Magician (Daemon, Extraplanar) Saberclaw* [(holy/shadow)] Winter Wolf* (Ice, [holy/shadow]) This spell functions like Summon Monster I , except that you can summon one creature from the 5th-level list with a CR rating of 6 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 4th-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 3rd-level or lower lists.
